elements.name: loft-14 Edit a placed section on a center-line loft

steps.name: a disposable copy of the native fixture "fixtures/cad/loft/circles-center-line-20.opd" is open
the user creates Loft1 from the two circular profiles and the 20 mm center line
the user edits Loft1, selects placed-sections mode, adds an intermediate section near the center-line midpoint and accepts it with alternate section size 1
the user edits Loft1 and double-clicks the intermediate point in the preview
Section Dimensions opens with the saved section settings
the user changes the alternate section size from 1 to 2 and accepts it
the displayed section area doubles and the loft preview bulges
the user accepts and reopens the loft and section dimensions
the user sets the section position distance to 5 mm on the 20 mm center line
the section moves and its position annotation reads 0.250000
